blocks.content: We started by learning different types of data:
To reuse these data later in the program, you can store them in variables. A variable will store data of a specific type.
If you need to perform calculations on the values or variables, use operators.
More on what you learned on the next page.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
